map.生成条数钳制在 1–50（缺省 5）；第 i 条按 i 对 4 取模循环选取 c: The number of generated items is clamped to 1–50 (default 5); item i cycles through four particle shapes — circle, square, diamond, star — by i modulo 4; each item takes a random count 20–200, color, size 2–10 px, speed 3–30 ÷ 10 (i.e. 0.3–3.0 s), spread radius 50–300 px, and opacity 3–8 ÷ 10 (i.e. 0.3–0.8). Animation keyframes: at 0% it moves down one spread radius with opacity 0; at 20% it rises to the set opacity; at 100% it moves up one spread radius with a random horizontal offset from −60 to 60 px and returns to opacity 0
map.CSS 粒子特效生成器。按生成数量批量产出可直接运行的粒子方案：每套包含完整的: A CSS particle effect generator. It batch-produces runnable particle schemes: each scheme ships complete HTML particle nodes plus CSS animation with `animation` already bound to the particle selector and every custom property (--size / --color / --speed / --spread / --opacity) actually referenced, so a copy-paste alone reproduces the effect. Every scheme also renders a live preview on the page.
map.可指定每套粒子数（20–200）、动画周期（0.3–3.0 s）与颜色，留空则随: Set particles per scheme (20–200), animation period (0.3–3.0 s) and colour, or leave blank for random values
map.四种粒子形状循环取用：圆形、方形、菱形、五角星，用 clip-path 实现: Four shapes cycle in order — circle, square, diamond, five-point star — all drawn with clip-path
map.输出「HTML 节点 + CSS」两段代码，动画真正绑定，不是只有变量声明: Outputs two copy-ready blocks (HTML nodes + CSS) with the animation genuinely bound, not just variable declarations
map.页面内实时预览，纯前端运行，数据不上传: Live in-page preview; runs entirely in the browser with no data upload
map.网页背景与落地页氛围特效: Web page backgrounds and landing-page ambience
map.活动页、抽奖页的粒子飘浮效果: Drifting particles for campaign and lucky-draw pages
map.无 JavaScript 依赖的纯 CSS 动效原型: Pure-CSS motion prototypes with no JavaScript dependency
map.教学演示 CSS 变量 + keyframes 的组合用法: Teaching how CSS custom properties and keyframes work together
map.生成条数钳制在 1–50（缺省 5）；第 i 条按 i 对 4 取模循环选取 c: The scheme count is clamped to 1–50 (default 5); scheme i picks its shape as i mod 4 (circle, square, diamond, star), drawn with clip-path so it never fights the transform animation. Each scheme takes 20–200 particles, a colour, a size of 2–10 px, a period of 0.3–3.0 s, a spread radius of 50–300 px and an opacity of 0.3–0.8 — specified or randomised when left blank. Output is "HTML particle nodes + CSS": .particles-N .p binds animation: float-N var(--speed) linear infinite, with --size / --color / --speed / --spread / --opacity all referenced, and each particle also carries left, animation-delay and --dx. Keyframes: 0% is one spread radius below with opacity 0; 20% reaches the configured opacity; 100% is one spread radius above with horizontal offset --dx and opacity back to 0
map.基于 CSS 关键帧的粒子系统：每个粒子是一个绝对定位的 span，靠 clip: A CSS-keyframe particle system: each particle is an absolutely positioned span whose shape comes from clip-path and whose rise and fade come from CSS custom properties plus keyframes — no JavaScript runtime needed. Output is two copy-ready blocks (HTML + CSS) along with a live preview. Suited to web page backgrounds and campaign-page effects.
map.按生成数量批量产出可直接运行的 CSS 粒子特效方案：可指定每套粒子数、动画周期: Batch-produce runnable CSS particle effects: set the particle count, animation period and colour per scheme (leave blank for random); each scheme ships ready-to-paste HTML particles plus CSS with the animation already bound, and renders a live preview.
map.由 0% / 20% / 100% 三个关键帧插值出 transform 与 o: transform and opacity are interpolated between the 0% / 20% / 100% keyframes on the compositor thread
map.粒子由 CSS 变量与 clip-path 绘制，按设备无关像素渲染，无需按 D: particles are drawn from CSS variables and clip-path, so they render in device-independent pixels without any DPR canvas scaling
map.负的 animation-delay 把同一动画周期的粒子相位错开，避免整批同步: a negative animation-delay offsets particles within the same animation period so the batch does not rise in lockstep
